name: file-connector
description: Let Hermes read files from disk in one call: PDF (scanned pages through the organisation's OCR model), Outlook .msg and .eml e-mails with their attachments, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML and text. Reads an attachment in place, saves attachments to a folder, renders PDF pages for a vision model. Read-only; a page with a text layer never leaves the machine.
